messages:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — we are opening a limited preview for the new Solo A200 dedicated micro-pools in Milan (eu-south-1) and Toronto (ca-central-1) starting tomorrow morning 08:00 UTC. :tada:
Ashish: Nice! Is this for reserved or burst capacity?
Morgan: Both — initial wave is reserve-eligible (monthly/annual commits). We'll also expose a small burst window for short experiments.
Priya: Any billing differences to call out?
Morgan: Price per-GPU is aligned with our high-memory tier; burst usage billed at on-demand rate. Reserved commits get standard discounts.
Liam: What about compatibility? model mapping, quantization etc.
Morgan: Solo A200 supports int8 quantized variants and our usual KV cache. SDK model name will be `redwood/solo-a200` (read-only mapping). Most LLMs currently routed to A100x will run fine, but we recommend testing end-to-end for QA.
Emma: Can you drop the reservation tag we should use?
Morgan: Use `dedicated:solo-a200` when creating reservations. For the console UI there will be a SKU selector named "Solo A200 (micro)".
Sara: Rollout plan? canaries?
Morgan: Canary starts 08:00 UTC with 2 micro-pools per region (low-traffic customers). If no regressions after 6h we open standard reservations and burst windows. Fallbacks: requests will automatically route to A100x or H200-compatible variants if Solo A200 capacity is exhausted.
ops-bot: DEPLOY-ALERT: Solo A200 micro-pool canary scheduled 2026-04-10T08:00:00Z. Monitoring hooks: `solo-a200-canary-health` attached.
Priya: Any quota impacts for existing customers?
Morgan: We will NOT automatically change existing reservations. Customers must opt-in to move commitments to Solo A200. However, fairshare for new micro-pools will take effect — small adjustments to rotational windows for the first week.
Ashish: Do we need to update docs / SDK?
Morgan: Docs PR is live: short guide + migration checklist. SDK will get a patch to expose the SKU name and a compatibility flag `supports_int8=true`. ETA for SDK rollout: tomorrow EOD.
Liam: Ops runbook pointers?
Morgan: Eng-runtime: see `/docs/ops/solo-a200-runbook.md` (internal). Key checks: kernel fallback latencies, mem-pressure alarms, and prewarm health.
Emma: Are there any limitations customers should know?
Morgan: Short list: 1) 32GB device mem (no L6 offload recommended), 2) single-node micro-pools only (no multi-GPU join), 3) current image supports CUDA 12.3.
Sara: I'll ping Sales + Support to prep messaging.
Morgan: Thanks — Sales heads-up: add "Solo A200 preview" to the region availability table. Support: we will create a canned response template and attach the runbook.
Ashish: TL;DR for internal comms?
Morgan: "Solo A200 micro-pools in Milan & Toronto — preview opens 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Reserve-eligible, small burst windows, use tag `dedicated:solo-a200`. Canaries for 6h, automatic fallback to A100x/H200 variants. See runbook + docs."
ops-bot: NOTE: Follow-up sync scheduled in #eng-runtime at 09:30 UTC to review canary metrics.
Priya: OK — I'll coordinate post-canary smoke tests.
Liam: I'll start a quick internal slack thread for perf numbers once canary begins.
Emma: :rocket: Good luck team — pls flag any regressions immediately in #eng-oncall.
Sara: Copy — prepping customer-facing blurb now.
Morgan: Appreciate it. We'll post an official announcement after the 6h health window if all clear.
